Name: PLAYER_COLORING_PRESET
Description: Preset colour schemes for the player AC. Each row is one preset with 14 colouring slots (likely one per AC part), each holding a pattern ID, two material property values and RGBA colours for the base, sub, support, optional and device colour groups.
